info.title: JvmBridge.Tool
info.description: The jvmbridge command: disassemble class files, preview what an agent's patches would change, and pack a native agent into a jar that java -javaagent can start.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Inspect class files, preview agent patches, and pack native agents for java -javaagent.

commands.name: dump
commands.description: Disassemble a class in the style of javap -c.

options.name: --class
options.description: The internal name of the class to dump from a jar, for example com/acme/Service. Without it the classes of the jar are listed.

options.name: --method
options.description: Dump only the methods with this name.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: A .class file, or a .jar that holds the class named by --class.

commands.name: patch
commands.description: Preview what an agent's patches would change in class files (needs --dry-run).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Only report what the patches would change. Required: the command does not write class files. [default: False]

options.name: --agent
options.description: The managed assembly of the agent: the .dll that dotnet build writes, before it is compiled to native code.

options.name: --classes
options.description: The classes to patch: .class files, directories of them, or .jar files.

options.name: --options
options.description: The agent options, as passed after the = of -agentpath or -javaagent. [default: ]

options.name: --disassemble
options.description: Also print the disassembly of every patched class. [default: False]

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Pack native agent libraries, or the jars of single platforms, into one jar for java -javaagent.

options.name: --agent
options.description: A native agent library for one platform as <rid>=<path>, for example linux-x64=bin/linux-x64/MyAgent.so. Repeat it for every platform.

options.name: --jar
options.description: A jar that jvmbridge pack or a publish with JvmBridgeAgentJar wrote, whose libraries go into the new jar. Repeat it to combine the jars of several platforms.
